lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: do you prefer

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: the traditional clothes I usually wear

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: or the swimsuit I wore at the beach?
Traditional clothes, I'd say.
Swimsuits are the way to go for summer.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Traditional clothes are indeed more elegant

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: and more fitting for the head of an organization.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: It was nice getting to wear a swimsuit.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: They feel particularly special since they're designed for the summer season.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Anyway, I asked because I was curious about your preference.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Thanks for answering my question.
Now that I think about it, it's rather regrettable to have to settle for just one.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: You are more greedy than I had anticipated.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Then again, it's only natural to yearn for what is beyond reach.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Just as the flowers in bloom differ with the seasons,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: it might also be nice for you to wait and see the different sides of me.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: your answer reminded me of something.
What is it?

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Something that Anis told me

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: when we were all at the beach.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: She said that if you wear a swimsuit under your usual clothes,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: it really gives you a leg up on the competition.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Do you know what she meant by that?
Um... it's a little difficult to explain.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Would you be so kind as to provide an explanation?
You don't need to know, honestly.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I'm the head of a large organization.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: For that, maintaining an edge is essential.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: If I can gain an advantage simply by changing my attire,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I will gladly do so.
Actually... Anis meant it in the sense you'd be more appealing to men.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Excuse me?
Particularly when you have some "private meetings" with them.
Sakura doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I must confess, I hadn't anticipated it to have such a meaning.
It's okay. I understand.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Do you feel that way, too, when you see me in that attire?
That's... a bit of an awkward question to answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind.
Hmm?

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Good bye for now.
Sakura?
Sakura does not reply.
